name: Scalpel EA
summary: Scalpel EA is a scalping expert advisor designed for high-frequency, low-profit-per-trade entries on small timeframes. It uses precise entry signals based on price action and technical indicators to capture small price movements with tight take-profit targets. The EA aims to accumulate profits through a large number of quick trades rather than holding positions for extended periods.
summary_zh: Scalpel EA是一款剥头皮交易专家顾问，专为小周期高频低利入场设计。它基于价格行为和技术指标产生精确入场信号，以紧密止盈目标捕捉小幅价格波动。该EA通过大量快速交易累积利润，而非长时间持仓。
strategy_analysis: Scalpel EA的策略核心是剥头皮交易，针对小时间框架（通常M1或M5）设计，追求每笔交易的小额利润。入场条件通常基于短期技术指标的交叉或超买超卖信号，结合价格行为确认，在市场波动较小时快速进出。出场条件采用紧密的止盈设定（通常5-15点），同时搭配止损以控制单笔亏损风险。仓位管理可能使用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，由于剥头皮策略交易频率高，需要特别注意点差和手续费对净收益的侵蚀效应，以及滑点对实际成交价的影响。整体策略依赖高胜率来弥补单笔利润较小的特征，需在低点差环境下运行效果最佳。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Scalpel EA is scalping, designed for small timeframes (typically M1 or M5), targeting small profits per trade. Entry conditions are typically based on short-term technical indicator crossovers or overbought/oversold signals combined with price action confirmation, executing quick in-and-out trades during low volatility periods. Exit conditions employ tight take-profit settings (usually 5-15 pips) along with stop-loss to control individual trade loss risk. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management requires special attention to spread and commission erosion on net returns due to the high trading frequency, as well as slippage impact on actual fill prices. The overall strategy relies on high win rates to compensate for small per-trade profits, and performs best in low-spread environments.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 剥头皮策略在高胜率条件下可稳定积累小额利润
紧密止损设定有效控制单笔交易风险
快速进出场减少持仓时间，降低隔夜风险和大幅波动暴露
小 timeframe 交易能捕捉更多市场微观波动机会
明确的止盈止损参数便于风险收益比量化评估
pros_en: Scalping strategy can steadily accumulate small profits under high win-rate conditions
Tight stop-loss settings effectively control individual trade risk
Quick entry and exit reduce holding time, lowering overnight risk and large move exposure
Small timeframe trading captures more micro-volatility market opportunities
Clear take-profit and stop-loss parameters facilitate quantitative risk-reward ratio evaluation
cons: 高频交易受点差和手续费严重侵蚀净利润
剥头皮策略对执行速度和滑点极其敏感，回测与实盘差异大
小止损容易被市场噪音触发导致频繁止损
策略在高波动或低流动性时段表现可能急剧恶化
依赖低点差经纪商环境，可移植性受限
cons_en: High-frequency trading is severely eroded by spread and commission costs on net profit
Scalping strategy is extremely sensitive to execution speed and slippage, causing large backtest vs live discrepancies
Small stop-losses are easily triggered by market noise leading to frequent stop-outs
Strategy performance may deteriorate sharply during high volatility or low liquidity sessions
Dependent on low-spread broker environments, limiting portability
improvements: 增加市场波动性过滤器（如ATR），在波动过大时暂停交易以避免不必要的止损
引入动态止盈止损机制，根据当前市场波动性自适应调整目标位
增加交易时段过滤，仅在流动性充足的时段交易以降低滑点影响
improvements_en: Add market volatility filter (e.g., ATR) to pause trading during excessive volatility and avoid unnecessary stop-outs
Introduce dynamic take-profit and stop-loss mechanism that adapts targets based on current market volatility
Add trading session filter to trade only during high-liquidity sessions to reduce slippage impact

risk_points: 剥头皮策略高频交易在点差扩大时可能造成连续亏损
小止损在市场噪音中容易被反复触发，造成频繁小额亏损累积
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一K线内多次重复开仓
risk_points_en: High-frequency scalping can cause consecutive losses when spreads widen
Small stop-losses can be repeatedly triggered by market noise, accumulating frequent small losses
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple repeated entries within the same bar
